messages:
Claire H: launching 0.5% canary for redwood-v3q2-int4 on /policy-assist. small but high-risk slice. pls watch semantic inversion and hallucination signals closely.
Roper J: ack. what's defined as semantic inversion for this sweep?
Claire H: our quick detector marks inversion when the variant's answer contradicts a ground-truth fact in curated eval set or flips polarity on yes/no prompts. threshold: >0.6% abs inversion OR embed_cos_drop >1.2% -> auto-rollback.
Mei L: interesting. suggest composite: require inversion OR (embed_drop + rouge_drop) combo to avoid false alarms from verbosity. Also add regulatory-weighted slice multiplier for policy templates.
safety-bot: rollout-bot: canary redwood-v3q2-int4 started at 1832100000 route=["/policy-assist"] size=0.5% policy=gradual
Claire H: kicking off 1k replay + 2% shadow. preflight includes contradiction-detector and a short A/B of 400 pairs using curated policy prompts.
Roper J: run tokenization hash check too; previous int4 kernels shifted EOS in long policy contexts.
Mei L: replay in progress, will post top diffs.
safety-bot: replay-job: replay-1832100000 completed samples=1000 summary: inversion_rate_overall=0.45% abs, policy_templates_slice=0.85% abs, embed_cos_drop_policy=1.4% abs, p99_lat_delta=70ms
Roper J: policy slice inversion 0.85% exceeds 0.6% threshold. embed drop also exceeds. this is a hard safety signal given compliance risk.
Claire H: rolling back now on /policy-assist. tagging runtime and safety for deep dive.
safety-bot: rollout-bot: rollback executed for redwood-v3q2-int4 on /policy-assist at 1832100250 by @Claire H
Mei L: attaching replay diffs and contradiction detector hits to the ticket. follow-ups: 1) add "semantic_inversion" gate to default rollout rules for policy/regulatory slices, 2) require 24h 5% shadow + 2k replay before re-onboard, 3) add an automated A/B contradiction check (500 pairs) in preflight.
Roper J: also propose weighting inversion by template impact and making rollback immediate for any inversion >0.5% on top-tier templates.
Claire H: agreed. i'll PR the gate change and update the onboarding checklist to flag policy templates as high-impact. thanks all)
